limitations: Complex ground field; the reduced support of the singular locus, not its nonreduced Jacobian subscheme. No claim about unrelated Segre projections or all positive-characteristic variants. Standard determinantal primeness, projective normality and toric divisor-class methods are used as known facts.
scientific_integrity: The monomial construction and the six-nodal threefold base case are established prior work. The evaluated result is the all-dimensional pointwise rank-one determinantal chart classification and canonical boundary, with a remaining risk of equivalent unindexed literature. Exact symbolic proofs, not finite computation, underpin the theorem.
title: Determinantal singularities of the doubly punctured binary Segre
